Strategic Research Operations

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Lab Data Technology Specialist at Nestlé Research within our Computational Sciences department, you will be responsible for reinforcing our laboratory data foundations to help unlock the full value of the data generated by our scientific instruments and laboratory systems. Sitting at the intersection of science, laboratory data, and modern data engineering, you will leverage latest data technologies and AI for coding tools to transform raw, heterogeneous scientific data into trusted, well-documented, and reusable data assets that accelerate impactful scientific research.

How you’ll make an impact as a Lab Data Technology Specialist

• Partner with laboratory stakeholders. data domain owners, lab business analysts together with data architects and engineers to translate functional requirements into scalable, and well-documented technical solutions, ensuring alignment between scientific workflows and technological capabilities

• Enable new and existing laboratory instruments end to end, from understanding the scientific workflow and data outputs to defining and establishing connectivity and data flow (LIMS, robotics, automation platforms, downstream systems), in collaboration with IT network, security specialists

• Collaborate with internal and external professionals to propose and implement customizations to lab digital platforms used (LIMS, instrument integration, technology specific data processing, metadata capture) in view of efficiency, quality, traceability, and governance by design

• Identify opportunities to increase value of lab data gathered across different sources by leveraging data technologies (data integrations, data warehousing, automated data quality checks, etc)

• Support testing, deployment, change management, and continuous improvement of compliant, scalable lab solutions, including AI-enabled opportunities to strengthen data flows and unlock value from lab data

What will make you successful

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a scientific or computational discipline (e.g., Chemistry, life sciences, Bioinformatics, Cheminformatics, Data Engineering, Computer Science), or equivalent experience.

• Solid experience in applying data engineering to scientific, laboratory data

• Required technical skills

•

• LIMS customization, data models, and integration.

• Integrating lab instruments, applications, robots, and IoT with reference databases and data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake).

• Solid grasp of the lab solutions ecosystem: ELN, CDS, LES, multi-omics pipelines, IoT-connected equipment, barcode systems, etc.

• Programming (e.g., Python, R, Java, Groovy).

• Data engineering and modeling — ETL/ELT (Airflow, dbt), APIs, orchestration, SQL/NoSQL — with engineering rigor (Git, CI/CD, testing, data quality, observability, reproducibility).

• Nice-to-have technical skills

• Semantic modeling, ontologies, and knowledge graphs (e.g., RDF/SPARQL, biomedical/chemical vocabularies).

• FAIR data implementation, metadata management, and lineage tooling

• Enabling AI/ML and analytics use cases on scientific data

• Domain exposure in chemistry, biology, food, or omics

• Reporting tools (e.g., DASH, Streamlit, Power BI) is an advantage

• Leveraging Agentic AI to automate data engineering activities

• Required non-technical skills

• Strong problem-solving and hands-on mindset

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

• Experience collaborating with external vendors and data professionals and driving delivery through others

• Ability to work in cross-functional and international teams

• Strong organizational and prioritization skills

• Fluent spoken and written English

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Gestalten Sie die Zukunft durch wissenschaftliche Durchbrüche und Innovationen.

Als Lab Data Technology Specialist bei Nestlé Research in unserer Computational Sciences-Abteilung sind Sie dafür verantwortlich, unsere Labordatengrundlagen zu stärken, um den vollen Wert der von unseren wissenschaftlichen Instrumenten und Laborsystemen generierten Daten zu erschließen. An der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft, Labordaten und moderner Datentechnik werden Sie die neuesten Datentechnologien und KI für Codierungswerkzeuge nutzen, um rohe, heterogene wissenschaftliche Daten in vertrauenswürdige, gut dokumentierte und wiederverwendbare Datenbestände umzuwandeln, die eine wirkungsvolle wissenschaftliche Forschung beschleunigen.

Wie Sie als Lab Data Technology Specialist etwas bewirken können

• Partnerschaft mit Laborbeteiligten. Datendomänenbesitzer, Labor-Business-Analysten zusammen mit Datenarchitekten und Ingenieuren, um funktionale Anforderungen in skalierbare und gut dokumentierte technische Lösungen zu übersetzen und so eine Abstimmung zwischen wissenschaftlichen Workflows und technologischen Fähigkeiten zu gewährleisten

• Ermöglichen Sie neue und bestehende Laborinstrumente durchgängig, vom Verständnis des wissenschaftlichen Workflows und der Datenausgaben bis hin zur Definition und Etablierung von Konnektivität und Datenfluss (LIMS, Robotik, Automatisierungsplattformen, nachgelagerte Systeme) in Zusammenarbeit mit IT-Netzwerken und Sicherheitsexperten.

• Identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten, den Wert von Labordaten aus verschiedenen Quellen zu erhöhen, indem Sie Datentechnologien nutzen (Datenintegrationen, Data Warehousing, automatisierte Datenqualitätsprüfungen usw.)

• Unterstützung von Testing, Deployment, Change Management und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung konformer, skalierbarer Laborlösungen, einschließlich KI-fähiger Möglichkeiten zur Stärkung des Datenflusses und zur Wertschöpfung aus Labordaten

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Solide Erfahrung in der Anwendung von Data Engineering auf wissenschaftliche Labordaten

• Erforderliche technische Fähigkeiten

•

• LIMS-Anpassung, Datenmodelle und Integration.

• Integration von Laborinstrumenten, Anwendungen, Robotern und IoT mit Referenzdatenbanken und Data Warehouses (z.B. Snowflake).

• Solides Verständnis des Ökosystems der Laborlösungen: ELN, CDS, LES, Multi-Omics-Pipelines, IoT-verbundene Geräte, Barcode-Systeme usw.

• Programmierung (z.B. Python, R, Java, Groovy).

• Data Engineering und Modellierung — ETL/ELT (Airflow, dbt), APIs, Orchestrierung, SQL/NoSQL — mit technischer Strenge (Git, CI/CD, Testen, Datenqualität, Beobachtbarkeit, Reproduzierbarkeit).

• Semantische Modellierung, Ontologien und Wissensgraphen (z. B. RDF / SPARQL, biomedizinische / chemische Vokabulare).

• Domänenexposition in Chemie, Biologie, Lebensmittel oder Omik

• Reporting-Tools (z.B. DASH, Streamlit, Power BI) sind von Vorteil

• Einsatz von Agentic AI zur Automatisierung von Data Engineering-Aktivitäten

• Starke Problemlösung und praktische Denkweise

Opérations de recherche stratégique

Lieu: Lausanne, Suisse
Modèle de travail: Hybride / Temps plein 100%
Type / durée du contrat : Permanent

Façonner l'avenir par des percées scientifiques et l'innovation.

En tant que spécialiste de la technologie des données de laboratoire chez Nestlé Research au sein de notre département des Sciences Computationnelles, vous serez chargé de renforcer nos bases de données de laboratoire pour aider à débloquer toute la valeur des données générées par nos instruments scientifiques et nos systèmes de laboratoire. Assis à l'intersection de la science, des données de laboratoire et de l'ingénierie moderne des données, vous tirerez parti des dernières technologies de données et de l'IA pour coder des outils permettant de transformer des données scientifiques brutes et hétérogènes en données fiables, bien documentées et réutilisables qui accélèrent la recherche scientifique.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que spécialiste de la technologie des données de laboratoire

• Partenaire avec les intervenants du laboratoire. propriétaires de domaines de données, analystes d'affaires de laboratoire, architectes de données et ingénieurs pour traduire les exigences fonctionnelles en solutions techniques évolutives et bien documentées, assurant l'alignement entre les flux de travail scientifiques et les capacités technologiques

• Permettre aux nouveaux et existants instruments de laboratoire de se terminer, de la compréhension du flux de travail scientifique et des sorties de données à la définition et à l'établissement de la connectivité et du flux de données (LIMS, robotique, plateformes d'automatisation, systèmes en aval), en collaboration avec le réseau informatique, les spécialistes de la sécurité

• Collaborer avec des professionnels internes et externes pour proposer et mettre en œuvre des personnalisations aux plateformes numériques de laboratoire utilisées (LIMS, intégration d'instruments, traitement de données spécifiques à la technologie, capture de métadonnées) en vue de l'efficacité, de la qualité, de la traçabilité et de la gouvernance par la conception

• Déterminer les possibilités d'accroître la valeur des données de laboratoire recueillies dans différentes sources en tirant parti des technologies de données (intégration des données, entreposage des données, contrôle automatisé de la qualité des données, etc.)

• Soutenir les essais, le déploiement, la gestion du changement et l'amélioration continue des solutions de laboratoire adaptables et évolutives, y compris les possibilités permettant de renforcer les flux de données et de débloquer la valeur des données de laboratoire

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en sciences ou en informatique (p. ex. chimie, sciences de la vie, bioinformatique, chimie, génie des données, informatique) ou expérience équivalente.

• Une solide expérience dans l'application de l'ingénierie des données aux données scientifiques et de laboratoire

• Compétences techniques requises

•

• Personnalisation LIMS, modèles de données et intégration.

• Intégrer les instruments de laboratoire, les applications, les robots et l'IdO avec les bases de données de référence et les entrepôts de données (p. ex., Snowflake).

• Une bonne compréhension de l'écosystème des solutions de laboratoire : ELN, CDS, ERP, pipelines multi-omiques, équipements connectés à l'IoT, systèmes de codes à barres, etc.

• Programmation (p. ex. Python, R, Java, Groovy).

• Ingénierie et modélisation des données — ETL/ELT (Airflow, dbt), API, orchestration, SQL/NoSQL — avec rigueur technique (Git, CI/CD, test, qualité des données, observabilité, reproductibilité).

• Bonnes compétences techniques

• Modélisation sémantique, ontologies et graphiques de connaissances (p. ex. RDF/SPARQL, vocabulaires biomédicaux/chimiques).

• Mise en œuvre des données FAIR, gestion des métadonnées et outils de lignage

• Valorisation des cas d'utilisation de l'IA/ML et de l'analyse sur les données scientifiques

• Exposition de domaine en chimie, biologie, nourriture ou omique

• Les outils de rapport (p. ex. DASH, Streamlit, Power BI) constituent un avantage

• Exploiter l'IA Agentic pour automatiser les activités d'ingénierie des données

• Compétences non techniques requises

• Forte résolution de problèmes et état d'esprit pratique

• Excellentes compétences en communication et gestion des parties prenantes

• Expérience de collaboration avec des fournisseurs externes et des professionnels des données et conduite de livraison par d'autres

• Capacité de travailler en équipes interfonctionnelles et internationales

• Compétences solides en matière d'organisation et de hiérarchisation

• Anglais parlé et écrit couramment

À Nestlé Research, nous plaçons les gens au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

Nos avantages sont conçus pour soutenir votre croissance et votre bien-être, afin que vous puissiez prospérer au travail et dans la vie:

• Options de travail flexibles, y compris les possibilités de travail hybride (pour les rôles de bureau)

• Jours fériés payés au-delà des exigences légales

• Possibilités d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement pour développer votre carrière

• Prime fondée sur les performances

• Contribution aux soins de santé et accès au Programme d'aide aux employés

• Une forte contribution de l'employeur à votre régime de retraite

• Congé parental généreux et solutions globales de soutien familial

• Réductions attrayantes pour les employés pour divers produits et services

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous nous engageons à offrir une expérience d'embauche inclusive et respectueuse et sommes heureux de fournir des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables au besoin. Nos lieux de travail sont entièrement accessibles et soutenus par une solide culture de sécurité, avec des installations et des procédures modernes pour assurer un environnement sécuritaire pour tous.

Le processus d'embauche comprend généralement une entrevue vidéo avec Talent Acquisition, une entrevue avec l'équipe d'embauche et une discussion et une offre finales. Nous examinons les candidatures reçues et clôturons le rôle une fois qu'une liste solide de candidats pertinents est établie. Nous vous encourageons donc à présenter votre candidature tôt. Toutes les informations sont traitées de façon confidentielle.

Restez vigilant : Nestlé communiquera uniquement avec les candidats par l'intermédiaire des adresses électroniques officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles à n'importe quelle étape du processus d'embauche.

Together, we make breakfast better.

As a Global SHE Lead at CPW, your mission is to lead and strengthen our Safety, Health and Environment strategy across our factories, distribution centers and Head Offices. You will make a difference by working closely with local SHE teams, factory leadership, and internal and external stakeholders. This is your opportunity to make breakfast better and help people start their day in the best possible way.

How you’ll make an impact as a Global SHE Lead

• Embed safety as a core leadership value by strengthening accountability and ensuring SHE is fully integrated into daily decision-making and operational routines.

• Drive SHE cultural transformation at shopfloor level by elevating frontline leadership behaviours through targeted coaching, and impactful communication.

• Deploy global SHE standards across CPW factories, ensuring consistency while enabling local ownership and high-performing safety cultures.

• Strengthen risk management and resilience by driving robust audit frameworks and proactive prevention plans to reduce operational risks.

• Build sustainable capability by developing factory leaders and SHE professionals, reinforcing expertise, mindset and long-term compliance.

• Accelerate continuous improvement by identifying, sharing and scaling best practices and innovative solutions across sites.

• Influence business performance by partnering cross-functionally to elevate SHE outcomes and support safe, sustainable operations.

What will make you successful

• Bringing proven experience in Safety within complex industrial environments, with a strong track record in driving safety culture transformation. Experience operating and influencing across regional or global organizations is a plus, while hands-on leadership experience at shopfloor level remains a strong advantage.

• Strong expertise in SHE management systems, auditing and risk management, complemented by recognized safety certifications (e.g., NEBOSH, ISO Lead Auditor or equivalent).

• Highly effective stakeholder influencer, able to engage, challenge and align leaders across functions, geographies and levels of the organization.

• Clear and impactful communicator, fluent in English (French is a plus), capable of connecting with audiences from shopfloor teams to senior leadership.

• Role model of CPW values, demonstrating collaboration, commitment, courage and capability in driving business and people outcomes.

At CPW, collaboration and purpose drive everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Strategic Research Operations

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

As a Scientific Data Product Manager at Nestlé Research in our Computational Sciences department, your mission will be to own the lifecycle of scientific data products across agriculture, packaging, clinical research, food safety, and health & nutrition scientific domains - reinforcing and increasing value of Nestlé Research's data foundations. You will identify high-value opportunities, translate scientific needs into impactful data products, and lead cross-functional delivery from discovery through adoption and communicate the same through an engaging product roadmap.

How you’ll make an impact as a Scientific Data Product Manager

• Lead cross-functional workstreams in a dynamic research environment, defining product vision, requirements, priorities, and success criteria that align science, data, and technology.

• Partner with scientific stakeholders to identify high-value needs, improve data quality, strengthen metadata, and make research data more discoverable and reusable through FAIR principles.

• Translate scientific needs into scalable data products across bioinformatics, clinical, and omics pipelines, from discovery through adoption.

• Orchestrate internal experts — including scientists, data domain owners, architects, data scientists, engineers, and software developers — together with external partners to accelerate priority delivery.

• Champion AI-enabled data products, using automation and AI to turn trusted, well-governed scientific data into faster, smarter insights.

• Own scientific data products for the long term, balancing feasibility and impact while using adoption, satisfaction, and delivered value to guide continuous improvement.

What will make you successful

• Bachelors or Master’s or PhD in Bioinformatics, Life sciences, Chemistry or Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent, combining scientific domain understanding with data expertise.

• Significant professional experience driving the seeding, implementation, adoption and lifecycle management of data products in a scientific context, preferably in food, life sciences or pharma.

• Required expertise:

•

• Solid experience with Bioinformatics or Clinical or Omics research data domains

• Proven ability to identify business and scientific needs, perform stakeholder analysis, translate requirements into product backlogs, and prioritize delivery based on value, feasibility and strategic alignment.

• Strong product ownership skills, including roadmap management, backlog prioritization, user-centric design, value definition, testing strategies, adoption tracking and continuous improvement.

• Solid understanding of data engineering concepts, including data models, pipelines, ETL/ELT, APIs, metadata, data quality, data governance and analytics architectures, with the ability to guide technical decisions and challenge proposals.

• Understanding of modern data ecosystems - cloud platforms, data warehouse, (e.g., Snowflake), Linux and container technologies, orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow), DevOps practices.

• Nice-to-have expertise

• Semantic modeling, ontologies, and knowledge graphs (e.g., RDF/SPARQL, biomedical/chemical vocabularies).

• FAIR data implementation, metadata management, and lineage tooling

• Experience with reporting tools (e.g., DASH, Streamlit, Power BI) is an advantage

• Leadership experience

• Experience coordinating delivery through multidisciplinary internal teams and external partners.

• Ability to navigate complexity, manage ambiguity and align scientific, business and technical stakeholders around clear priorities.

• Experience in mentoring or guiding junior resources

• Excellent problem-solving, strong communication, stakeholder management and knowledge-sharing skills

• Fluent spoken and written English

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

descriptionByLocale.en:
Location: Vers-chez-les-Blanc, Switzerland
Work model: Full time
Contract type / duration: 2 years limited contract

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation

As an Associate Specialist Lipids at Nestlé Research, your mission is to strengthen scientific expertise and generate new insights in lipid physics and chemistry for food applications. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with multidisciplinary research teams, product development teams, expert networks, innovation partners, suppliers, universities, and research institutes. This is your opportunity to turn ideas into sustainable and innovative solutions for people, pets, and the planet.

How you’ll make an impact as an Associate Specialist Lipids

• Building scientific knowledge of emerging methods, trends, and discoveries in lipid science and technology.

• Developing robust scientific concepts that translate lipid research into food applications and consumer benefits.

• Leading research projects and communicating scientific approaches and results to technical and business audiences.

• Designing and executing laboratory studies that advance understanding of lipid crystallisation, structuring, and oxidation.

• Transferring scientific knowledge to development teams to accelerate innovation projects and successful product launches.

• Strengthening scientific visibility through intellectual property, publications, conference presentations, and coaching of students and technicians.

What will make you successful

• Holding a PhD in Food Science/Chemistry, Food Engineering, or a related area, with strong knowledge of lipid science, including lipid crystallisation, structuring, and oxidation.

• Applying analytical thinking and problem-solving to turn science and technology into consumer and business value.

• Using project management, organisation, and communication skills to deliver clear scientific outcomes.

• Collaborating proactively across disciplines while showing initiative, integrity, and a passion for knowledge sharing.

• Communicating fluently in English; additional languages are an advantage.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset, to create shared value.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. Depending on the role, a video assessment may be included. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to #BreakthroughTogether?

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ubicazione: La Tour-de-Peilz, Svizzera
Modello di lavoro: ibrido / tempo pieno
Tipo di contratto / durata: Permanente

Essere una forza per il bene e crescere attraverso esperienze che ti spingono oltre

In qualità di Brand Experience Specialist presso Nestlé Suisse S.A., la vostra missione è di ringiovanire THOMY e approfondire la lealtà dei consumatori offrendo esperienze di brand integrate che rafforzano la connessione emotiva e spingono la crescita sostenibile. Potrai fare la differenza collaborando a stretto contatto con marketing, vendite, comunicazioni, team di food-service, agenzie e partner di sponsorizzazione. Questa è la vostra opportunità di prendere la proprietà, crescere la vostra esperienza, e fare la differenza in scala.

Come farete un impatto come specialista di Brand Experience

• Trasformando intuizioni di consumatori, culturali e di categoria in esperienze di marca convincenti che crescono la rilevanza del marchio e l'impatto commerciale.

• Definire una strategia di attivazione omnicanale che crea un'esperienza di THOMY senza soluzione di continuità attraverso il canale OOH / convenienza.

• Attivare una rete esterna per costruire partnership di sponsorizzazione locali di alto valore che espandono la visibilità, rafforzino il significato del marchio e sbloccano la crescita sostenibile.

• Sviluppare ed eseguire le attivazioni del marchio, eventi di marketing dal vivo e le esperienze del marchio che convertono la partecipazione in una duratura fedeltà, impegno e advocacy.

• Fornire piani di amplificazione integrati che collegano ogni attivazione alle priorità del marchio e risultati aziendali misurabili.

• Guidare l'esecuzione eccellente attraverso una collaborazione chiara, allocazione intelligente delle risorse e apprendimento continuo dai risultati.

Che cosa vi farà successo

• Portando una forte esperienza nel marketing del marchio, nell'attivazione dei consumatori, nelle comunicazioni o nel marketing degli shopper, agendo come ambasciatore appassionato di THOMY sia internamente che esternamente.

• Applicando conoscenze di mercato Out-of-Home per fornire attivazioni omnichannel integrate che rafforzano la visibilità del marchio e i risultati aziendali di guida in tutta la regione, supportato dalla flessibilità di viaggiare regolarmente e dalla valida licenza del conducente.

• Utilizzando le conoscenze dei consumatori, le metriche delle prestazioni e le competenze di gestione del bilancio per ottimizzare l'esecuzione, misurare l'efficacia e massimizzare il ritorno sugli investimenti.

• Collaborare efficacemente con le agenzie, i partner esterni e i team interfunzionali, mentre i progetti principali da breve a successo implementazione.

• Comunicare fluentemente in tedesco / tedesco svizzero e inglese.

• Dimostrare coraggio, collaborazione, velocità e apprendimento continuo.

Cosa aspettarsi dal nostro processo di assunzione

Ci impegniamo a un processo di assunzione interno equo e trasparente e assicuriamo che tutte le applicazioni siano trattate con riservatezza.

La tua applicazione in genere includerà una recensione iniziale, conversazioni con Talent Acquisition e il team di assunzione, seguita da una discussione finale.

Rimanere vigili: Nestlé contatterà i candidati solo tramite gli indirizzi e-mail ufficiali della società e non chiederà mai pagamenti o informazioni personali sensibili in qualsiasi fase del processo di assunzione.

Pronti a crescere con noi?

Applicare ora e crescere attraverso esperienze che ti spingono oltre.

Als Brand Experience Specialist bei Nestlé Suisse S.A. ist es Ihre Mission, THOMY zu verjüngen und die Kundenbindung zu vertiefen, indem Sie integrierte Markenerlebnisse liefern, die die emotionale Verbindung stärken und nachhaltiges Wachstum vorantreiben. Wie Sie als Brand Experience Specialist etwas bewirken

• Verwandeln Sie Verbraucher-, Kultur- und Kategorieerkenntnisse in überzeugende Markenerlebnisse, die Markenrelevanz und kommerzielle Auswirkungen erhöhen.

• Gestaltung einer Omnichannel-Aktivierungsstrategie, die ein nahtloses THOMY-Erlebnis über den OOH / Convenience-Kanal schafft.

• Aktivierung eines externen Netzwerks zum Aufbau hochwertiger lokaler Sponsoring-Partnerschaften, die die Sichtbarkeit erhöhen, die Markenbedeutung stärken und nachhaltiges Wachstum ermöglichen.

• Entwicklung und Durchführung von Markenaktivierungen, Live-Marketing-Events und Markenerfahrungen, die die Teilnahme in dauerhafte Loyalität, Engagement und Interessenvertretung umwandeln.

• Bereitstellung integrierter Verstärkungspläne, die jede Aktivierung mit Markenprioritäten und messbaren Geschäftsergebnissen verbinden.

• Führen Sie eine hervorragende Ausführung durch klare Zusammenarbeit, intelligente Ressourcenzuweisung und kontinuierliches Lernen aus den Ergebnissen.

Was dich erfolgreich macht

• Wir bringen starkes Know-how in den Bereichen Markenmarketing, Verbraucheraktivierung, Kommunikation oder Käufermarketing mit und sind gleichzeitig als leidenschaftlicher Botschafter für THOMY sowohl intern als auch extern tätig.

• Anwendung von Out-of-Home-Marktwissen, um integrierte Omnichannel-Aktivierungen zu liefern, die die Markensichtbarkeit stärken und die Geschäftsergebnisse in der Region steigern, unterstützt durch die Flexibilität, regelmäßig zu reisen und einen gültigen Führerschein.

• Verwendung von Consumer Insights, Performance-Metriken und Budgetmanagement-Expertise zur Optimierung der Ausführung, Messung der Effektivität und Maximierung des Return on Investment.

• Effektive Zusammenarbeit mit Agenturen, externen Partnern und funktionsübergreifenden Teams, während Projekte von der kurzen bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung geleitet werden.

• Fließend kommunizieren in Schweizer Deutsch/Deutsch und Englisch.

• Demonstration von Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Geschwindigkeit und kontinuierlichem Lernen.

Was Sie von unserem Einstellungsprozess erwarten können

Wir verpflichten uns zu einem fairen und transparenten internen Einstellungsprozess und stellen sicher, dass alle Bewerbungen vertraulich behandelt werden.

Ihre Bewerbung umfasst in der Regel eine erste Überprüfung, Gespräche mit Talent Acquisition und dem Einstellungsteam, gefolgt von einer abschließenden Diskussion.

Bleiben Sie wachsam: Nestlé wird Kandidaten nur über offizielle Firmen-E-Mail-Adressen kontaktieren und zu keinem Zeitpunkt des Einstellungsprozesses Zahlungen oder sensible persönliche Informationen verlangen.

Bereit, mit uns zu wachsen?

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und wachsen Sie durch Erfahrungen, die Sie weiter vorantreiben.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Lieu: La Tour-de-Peilz, Suisse
Modèle de travail: Hybride / Temps plein
Type / durée du contrat : Permanent

Être une force pour le bien et grandir à travers des expériences qui vous poussent plus loin

En tant que spécialiste de l'expérience de la marque chez Nestlé Suisse S.A., votre mission est de rajeunir THOMY et d'approfondir la loyauté des consommateurs en offrant des expériences de marque intégrées qui renforcent la connexion émotionnelle et stimulent une croissance durable. Vous ferez une différence en collaborant étroitement avec le marketing, les ventes, les communications, les équipes de services alimentaires, les agences et les partenaires de parrainage. C'est l'occasion pour vous de prendre en main, de développer votre expertise et de faire une différence à l'échelle.

Comment vous allez faire un impact en tant que spécialiste de l'expérience de la marque

• Transformer les connaissances des consommateurs, des cultures et des catégories en expériences de marque convaincantes qui augmentent la pertinence de la marque et son impact commercial.

• Façonner une stratégie d'activation omnicanale qui crée une expérience THOMY transparente à travers le canal OOH / pratique.

• Activer un réseau externe pour créer des partenariats de parrainage locaux de grande valeur qui accroissent la visibilité, renforcent le sens de la marque et permettent une croissance durable.

• Développer et exécuter des activations de marque, des événements de marketing en direct et des expériences de marque qui transforment la participation en fidélité, engagement et plaidoyer durables.

• Fournir des plans d'amplification intégrés qui relient chaque activation aux priorités de marque et aux résultats opérationnels mesurables.

• Conduire une excellente exécution grâce à une collaboration claire, une allocation intelligente des ressources et un apprentissage continu des résultats.

Ce qui vous fera réussir

• Apporter une solide expertise dans le marketing de marque, l'activation des consommateurs, les communications, ou le marketing d'achat, tout en agissant comme un ambassadeur passionné de THOMY à l'interne et à l'externe.

• Appliquer les connaissances du marché extérieur pour offrir des activations omnicanales intégrées qui renforcent la visibilité de la marque et stimulent les résultats commerciaux dans toute la région, soutenues par la flexibilité de voyager régulièrement et un permis de conduire valide.

• Utiliser les connaissances des consommateurs, les mesures du rendement et l'expertise en gestion budgétaire pour optimiser l'exécution, mesurer l'efficacité et maximiser le rendement des investissements.

• Collaborer efficacement avec les organismes, les partenaires externes et les équipes interfonctionnelles tout en menant des projets de courte durée à une mise en oeuvre réussie.

• Communiquer couramment en allemand/allemand et en anglais.

• Démontrer le courage, la collaboration, la rapidité et l'apprentissage continu.

À quoi s'attendre de notre processus d'embauche

Nous nous engageons à mettre en place un processus d'embauche interne équitable et transparent et nous veillons à ce que toutes les demandes soient traitées de façon confidentielle.

Votre demande comprendra généralement un examen initial, des conversations avec Talent Acquisition et l'équipe d'embauche, suivies d'une discussion finale.

Restez vigilant : Nestlé communiquera uniquement avec les candidats par l'intermédiaire des adresses électroniques officielles de l'entreprise et ne demandera jamais de paiements ou de renseignements personnels sensibles à n'importe quelle étape du processus d'embauche.

Prêt à grandir avec nous ?

Appliquer maintenant et grandir à travers des expériences qui vous poussent plus loin.

Location: Lausanne, Switzerland
Work model: Onsite / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Start date: January 1, 2027

Deadline for applications : October 7, 2026

Shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation

As a Community Manager at Nestlé Research, your mission is to strengthen employee engagement, belonging, and connection across Nestlé Research and the wider Research and Development community. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with employees, leaders, sites, functions, and communities.

How you’ll make an impact as a Community Manager

• Strengthening employee engagement and belonging through meaningful initiatives that connect people across sites and communities.

• Creating engaging communication moments, campaigns, events, and digital content that inspire participation and shared purpose.

• Listening to employees and turning community insights (e.g. through surveys) into relevant actions that improve the employee experience.

• Building trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels to connect people needs with business priorities.

• Facilitating conversations and translating complex topics into clear, accessible messages that build understanding and momentum.

• Delivering initiatives with structure, creativity, and quality to create visible impact for employees and the organization.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong experience in employee engagement, internal communications, community management, events, or related community-building fields.

• Applying creativity, storytelling, and digital communication skills to design engaging formats, campaigns, and content.

• Using strong project management and organizational skills to deliver several initiatives in parallel with quality and impact.

• Collaborating confidently with diverse stakeholders, including leaders, while influencing with diplomacy and a solution-oriented mindset.

• Communicating fluently in English; working proficiency in French is a strong asset.

• Bringing collaboration, fresh thinking, bold questions, respect, and a positive, wellbeing-oriented mindset, to create shared value.

At Nestlé Research, we place people at the core of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and final discussions and offer. Depending on the role, a video assessment may be included. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to #BreakthroughTogether?

Apply now and shape the future through scientific breakthroughs and innovation.

Be a force for good and help nurture a healthier generation

Als Milch-/Lebensmitteltechnologe Anlageführer im 1-Schichtbetrieb bei Nestlé Nutrition & Health ist deine Mission, hochwertige Produkte und Versuche sicher, zuverlässig und effizient auf unseren Produktionsanlagen umzusetzen. Du machst einen Unterschied, indem du eng mit Produktionsteams, Entwicklung, Qualität, Technik und Werkstatt zusammenarbeitest. Dies ist deine Chance, bedeutende Ergebnisse zu erzielen, die weltweit durch Ernährungsinnovation zur Verbesserung des Lebens beitragen.

So bewirkst du etwas als Milch-/Lebensmitteltechnologe Anlageführer im 1-Schichtbetrieb

• Produktherstellung unter Einhaltung der Sicherheitsvorschriften und nach NGMP/SOPs

• Vorbereitung und Durchführung der Versuche

• Erstellen von Arbeitsanweisungen, Versuchsprotokollen und Produktionsunterlagen

• Einbringen von Verbesserungsvorschlägen bei der Entwicklung neuer Produkte und Prozesse

• Mithilfe bei der Verbesserung bestehender Produkte und Verfahren

• Störungsbehebung und Wartungsarbeiten an Prozesslinien in Zusammenarbeit mit der Werkstatt

Das macht dich erfolgreich

• Ausbildung als Milch- oder Lebensmitteltechnologe oder in einem anderen Nahrungsmittelberuf

• Gutes technisches Verständnis der Produktionsanlagen

• Berufserfahrung im Bereich von Eindampfung und Sprühtrocknung von Vorteil

• Neugier und Interesse für die Entwicklung von neuen Verfahren und Produkten

• Mündliche und schriftliche Englischkenntnisse oder die Bereitschaft, diese zu erlernen

• Soziale Kompetenz und Teamfähigkeit

• MS-Office-Anwenderkenntnisse

Bei Nestlé Product & Technology Center Nutrition & Health stellen wir Menschen in den Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns

Unsere Benefits unterstützen dein Wachstum und dein Wohlbefinden, damit du bei der Arbeit und im Leben erfolgreich sein kannst:

• Bezahlte Ferien über die gesetzlichen Anforderungen hinaus

• Beitrag an die Gesundheitsversorgung und Employee Assistance Program für dich und deine Familie

• Starker Arbeitgeberbeitrag an deine Pensionskasse

• Leistungsbasierter Bonus

• Grosszügiger Elternurlaub und umfassende Unterstützungslösungen für Familien

• Lern- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen

• Attraktive Mitarbeitendenrabatte auf Alltagsprodukte und Dienstleistungen

Was dich in unserem Rekrutierungsprozess erwartet

Wir setzen uns für eine inklusive und respektvolle Rekrutierungserfahrung ein und stellen bei Bedarf gerne angemessene Anpassungen bereit. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden durch eine starke Sicherheitskultur unterstützt, mit modernen Anlagen und Verfahren, die ein sicheres Umfeld für alle gewährleisten.

Der Rekrutierungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Gespräch mit Talent Acquisition, ein Gespräch mit dem Hiring Team sowie eine finale Diskussion und ein Angebot. Wir prüfen Bewerbungen fortlaufend und schliessen die Stelle, sobald eine starke Auswahl passender Kandidat:innen identifiziert wurde. Deshalb empfehlen wir dir, dich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Ready to Be a Force for Good?

descriptionByLocale.en:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid
Contract type / duration: Temporary – 12 months
Target start date: Q1 2027, flexible
Deadline for applications: 16 October 2026

Be a force for good and take your NeStep with Nestlé

NeStep is a unique 12-month immersive experience at Nestlé in Switzerland for fresh graduates who want to learn fast, grow with purpose and make an impact. From day one, you spend at least half of your time owning one impactful project, combined with structured learning and continuous mentoring to deliver meaningful results.

As a NeStep talent in Packaging Innovation at the Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee, your mission is to support the development and implementation of more sustainable paper-based packaging solutions for coffee products while helping deliver a superior consumer experience. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with packaging specialists, project teams, internal research and development partners, marketing, business teams, operations, laboratories and external suppliers. This is your opportunity to learn by doing, grow with support and shape the future you envision for yourself and for the world around you.

How you’ll make an impact as a NeStep talent in Packaging Innovation

• Supporting the development and implementation of innovative paper-based packaging solutions for coffee products, including flexible and rigid formats.

• Contributing to packaging material changes from plastic to paper while helping maintain functionality, quality and consumer experience.

• Coordinating laboratory activities, technical testing and trials, then turning results into clear summaries and recommendations for project teams.

• Collaborating with internal partners and external suppliers to explore new materials, packaging formats and technical solutions.

• Creating mock-ups, prototypes, sketches or renderings that bring new packaging concepts to life and support decision-making.

What will make you successful

• Master’s graduate in Packaging Engineering, Materials Science, Industrial Design or a related field, with a strong interest in packaging innovation.

• Being agile, organized and proactive, with the ability to manage several activities, adapt to evolving priorities and turn technical information into clear insights.

• Having strong collaboration and communication skills, with the confidence to work with laboratories, project teams, business partners and suppliers.

• Having fluency in English; French is an asset.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

Eligibility criteria

• Being a recent graduate from a Swiss higher education institution (bachelor's or master's degree completed within last 12 months).

• Swiss nationals, EU/EFTA nationals, or C permit holders only.

At Nestlé , we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities, including mentoring and coaching

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

• Potential reward for outstanding contribution

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to learn, grow and be a force for good?

Apply now and take your NeStep with Nestlé.

Arbeitsmodell: Vor Ort

Be a force for good and help nurture a healthier generation

Als Polymechaniker:in EFZ bei Nestlé Nutrition & Health ist es deine Mission, die mechanischen Anlagen und die Infrastruktur an unserem Forschungs- und Entwicklungszentrum in Konolfingen zu warten und zu verbessern. Du bewirkst etwas, indem du eng mit Kolleg:innen aus dem Engineering, technischen Teams und Produktionspartnern zusammenarbeitest. Dies ist deine Gelegenheit, dein Fachwissen auszubauen und bedeutungsvolle Ergebnisse zu erzielen, die durch Ernährungsinnovationen weltweit zur Verbesserung des Lebens beitragen.

So bewirkst du als Polymechaniker:in EFZ etwas

• Warten mechanischer Anlagen und der Infrastruktur zur Unterstützung eines sicheren und zuverlässigen Betriebs.

• Verbessern von Maschinen und Anlagen zur Stärkung der Leistung und langfristigen Zuverlässigkeit.

• Leisten technischer Unterstützung bei Versuchen, damit Teams erfolgreiche Ergebnisse erzielen.

• Fertigen und Anpassen von Präzisionsteilen aus Edelstahl, Metall und Kunststoff zur Erfüllung betrieblicher Anforderungen.

• Prüfen von Maschinen nach Bedarf, um Funktionalität, Sicherheit und Einsatzbereitschaft zu bestätigen.

• Unterstützen der Standortdienste und technischen Bereitschaftseinsätze, damit kritische Aktivitäten reibungslos weiterlaufen.

Damit überzeugst du uns

• Du bringst fundierte praktischer Kenntnisse in der mechanischen Instandhaltung und Anlagenoptimierung mit, einschliesslich computergesteuerter Werkzeugmaschinen.

• Du wendest Fachwissen in der Fertigung und Anpassung von Edelstahlkomponenten und weiteren Präzisionsteilen erfolgreich an.

• Du setzt ausgeprägte Organisationsfähigkeit und eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise ein, um technische Prioritäten wirksam zu steuern.

• Eine konstruktive Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleg:innen mit ausgeprägtem Sicherheitsbewusstsein.

• Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse und gute Arbeitskenntnissen der Englischen Sprach.

• Du zeigst Mut, Zusammenarbeit, Schnelligkeit und kontinuierliches Lernen, setzt Ideen in Massnahmen mit messbaren Auswirkungen um und kreierst gemeinsamen Mehrwert.

Das erwartet dich in unserem Bewerbungsprozess

Wir setzen uns für einen inklusiven und respektvollen Bewerbungsprozess ein und stellen bei Bedarf gerne angemessene Anpassungen bereit. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind vollständig zugänglich und werden von einer starken Sicherheitskultur getragen, mit modernen Anlagen und Verfahren, die ein sicheres Umfeld für alle gewährleisten.

Der Bewerbungsprozess umfasst in der Regel ein Gespräch mit Talent Acquisition, ein Gespräch mit dem einstellenden Team sowie ein abschliessendes Gespräch und ein Angebot. Wir prüfen Bewerbungen, sobald sie eingehen, und schliessen die Stelle, sobald eine gute Auswahl relevanter Kandidat:innen gefunden wurde. Deshalb empfehlen wir dir, dich frühzeitig zu bewerben. Alle Informationen werden vertraulich behandelt.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Location: Konolfingen, Switzerland
Contract type / duration: Internship, 6 months
Start date: January/February 2026
Deadline for Application:

Be a force for good and transform your potential into something extraordinary

As a Product Development Intern at Nestlé, your mission is to support the Powder Creamer Team in developing new solutions that optimize powder properties and manufacturing processes. You will make a difference by collaborating closely with Product Development Specialists, project team members and relevant NPTC stakeholders. This is your opportunity to make an impact while gaining hands-on experience and mentorship to kick-start your career.

How you’ll make an impact as a Product Development Intern

• Support R&D product development projects and design experiments to identify powder creamer solutions with defined functional and sensory properties.

• Plan, prepare and conduct kitchen, benchtop, prototyping and pilot plant trials, including the preparation of prototypes for validation.

• Coordinate raw materials, product analytics, sample releases, sensory evaluations and keeping-quality tests.

• Assess the sustainability impact of developed solutions in collaboration with the project manager.

• Document, report and present project results while building effective collaboration with project team members and relevant NPTC stakeholders.

What will make you successful

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in progress or completed in Science and Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering or a related field, with exposure to materials science, chemistry or physics.

• Strong interest in innovation and a problem-solving mindset, supported by hands-on curiosity and a willingness to learn.

• Good communication and networking skills, with experience collaborating in multidisciplinary teams and building relationships based on trust.

• Fluency in English. German is a strong asset.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office-based roles)

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes an interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to start your career journey with us?

Apply now and transform your potential into something extraordinary.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Associate R&D Specialist Flavors

Nestlé Institute of Food Sciences

Welcome to Nestlé Research, a global organization, with most of our passionate team located in Lausanne, Switzerland! Our work is powered by five specialized Nestlé Institutes and key strategic units. Here, we think fresh and collaborate to create amazing solutions. How about taking a step inside our organization and discover the exciting research activities and expertise that drive us forward? Want to learn more !

Position Snapshot: Your opportunity to #breakthrough with us!

Location: Nestlé Research, Lausanne, Switzerland

Institute: Nestlé Institute of Food Science

Company: Société des Produits Nestlé S.A.
Act. Rate: Full-Time Act. Rate 100%
Type of contract: 2-year contract

What we offer at Nestlé

Exciting opportunities to develop your career your way; across different brands, businesses, functions, and regions.

Flexible working arrangements - facilitating creativity and collaboration.

A culture of respect, with diversity, equity and inclusion at its core.

A dynamic international environment empowering you to learn, develop and grow.

Don’t hesitate to connect with us during the recruitment process to learn more

Position Summary

As an “ Associate R&D Specialist Flavors” in Nestlé Research, you will be instrumental in advancing the innovation and renovation within Flavor Science. Your work will span across all categories in Nestlé, catering both tasty and nutritious products, for consumers and their pet friends.

Thanks to your passion and scientific expertise, you will develop robust scientific and innovative solutions to decode and modulate taste and aroma in order to enhance sensory experiences for our consumers. Collaborating with multidisciplinary experts, you will drive the collection, interpretation and application of scientific findings into the development of new product concepts and address business opportunities. You will also have the opportunity to shape and implement the future scientific strategy in this field, engaging with internal and external experts and various business partners.

A Day in the Life of an Associate R&D Specialist Flavors

• Embrace innovation as a catalyst for change: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive cutting-edge research in aroma and taste mastery, leveraging your flavor expertise and developing impactful prototypes. Communicate effectively with impact to different stakeholders, e.g., institute heads, stream leaders, project managers, and business stakeholders. Propose new projects and activities that align with our research goals and business needs.

• Make a meaningful impact on our world: Lead project activities to meet defined objectives and timelines, coordinating with experts in sensory science, perception physiology, and material science. Manage project budgets effectively and ensure seamless knowledge transfer to Product Technology Centers.

• Foster a culture of creativity and growth : Engage with diverse thought leaders to spark fresh ideas and entrepreneurial initiatives. Identify technical gaps and opportunities and stay updated on the latest trends and methods. Propose innovative ideas by merging technical knowledge with business insights and exploring external partnerships.

• Stay at the forefront of science by monitoring the latest development in flavor sciences, and sharing relevant external technologies in both academia and industry

What Will Make You Successful

• Ph.D. in Food Chemistry and Food Sciences with knowledge of flavor generation and transformation, ideally with industrial experience

• Research and applied science experience in the field of reaction flavours, Maillard reactions, lipid oxidations, and linking to sensory benefits

• Practical experience in analytical laboratory, with a focus on volatile and non-volatiles (GC-MS, GC-O, LC/MS)

• Proficiency in programming languages, e.g. Python & R, and experience in statistical analysis (e.g., PLS and PCA) and data visualization

• Basic knowledge of sensory techniques

• Ability to translate complex scientific results to easily understood way that instils credibility across different stakeholders

• Excellent communication skills in English (written/spoken)

• Networking skills and proactivity

• People at Core: Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively in diverse teams, fostering an environment that encourages fresh thinking and values contributions. Display openness, flexibility, and creativity in problem-solving while cultivating strong networking and teamwork abilities

• Innovation at Heart: Proven track record in driving innovative projects that challenge the status quo and contribute to breakthrough solutions, alongside experience in modeling or diet formulation

• Driven by Passion, Inspired by People: Strong commitment to promoting well-being and a positive workplace culture, ensuring all team members feel valued

Exciting Opportunity Ahead! After submitting your application, you will receive an invitation to create a short video introduction, guided by a few specific questions. This is your chance to showcase your personality and passion.

We kindly ask that you submit your video within 7 days of your application to ensure we can assess your profile thoroughly. Please note that if this step is not completed within the specified time, we will assume you have chosen to withdraw your application

Nestlé is committed to the accessibility of its recruitment process. If you require an adaptation during the recruitment process, please do let us know so we can support you effectively. All information will be treated confidentially.

At Nestlé, we want to help shape a better and healthier world, inspire people to live healthier lives and deliver impact at a scale and pace that makes a difference. We do this by fostering a diverse, friendly, supportive, and collaborative environment, that creates positive disruption, embraces innovation, and empowers people and teams to win. We aim to hire friendly, respectful, inspiring people who care about the people’s lives that we touch every single day.

Be a force for good. Join Nestlé and visit us on www.nestle.com .

Nestlé Institute of Food Sciences

Welcome to Nestlé Research, a global organization, with most of our passionate team located in Lausanne, Switzerland! Our work is powered by five specialized Nestlé Institutes and key strategic units. Here, we think fresh and collaborate to create amazing solutions. How about taking a step inside our organization and discover the exciting research activities and expertise that drive us forward? Want to learn more !

Position Snapshot: Your opportunity to #breakthrough with us!

Location: Nestlé Research, Lausanne, Switzerland

Institute: Nestlé Institute of Food Science

Company: Société des Produits Nestlé S.A.
Act. Rate: Full-Time Act. Rate 100%
Type of contract: 2-year contract

What we offer at Nestlé

Exciting opportunities to develop your career your way; across different brands, businesses, functions, and regions.

Flexible working arrangements - facilitating creativity and collaboration.

A culture of respect, with diversity, equity and inclusion at its core.

A dynamic international environment empowering you to learn, develop and grow.

Don’t hesitate to connect with us during the recruitment process to learn more

Position Summary

As an “ Associate R&D Specialist Flavors” in Nestlé Research, you will be instrumental in advancing the innovation and renovation within Flavor Science. Your work will span across all categories in Nestlé, catering both tasty and nutritious products, for consumers and their pet friends.

Thanks to your passion and scientific expertise, you will develop robust scientific and innovative solutions to decode and modulate taste and aroma in order to enhance sensory experiences for our consumers. Collaborating with multidisciplinary experts, you will drive the collection, interpretation and application of scientific findings into the development of new product concepts and address business opportunities. You will also have the opportunity to shape and implement the future scientific strategy in this field, engaging with internal and external experts and various business partners.

A Day in the Life of an Associate R&D Specialist Flavors

• Embrace innovation as a catalyst for change: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive cutting-edge research in aroma and taste mastery, leveraging your flavor expertise and developing impactful prototypes. Communicate effectively with impact to different stakeholders, e.g., institute heads, stream leaders, project managers, and business stakeholders. Propose new projects and activities that align with our research goals and business needs.

• Make a meaningful impact on our world: Lead project activities to meet defined objectives and timelines, coordinating with experts in sensory science, perception physiology, and material science. Manage project budgets effectively and ensure seamless knowledge transfer to Product Technology Centers.

• Foster a culture of creativity and growth : Engage with diverse thought leaders to spark fresh ideas and entrepreneurial initiatives. Identify technical gaps and opportunities and stay updated on the latest trends and methods. Propose innovative ideas by merging technical knowledge with business insights and exploring external partnerships.

• Stay at the forefront of science by monitoring the latest development in flavor sciences, and sharing relevant external technologies in both academia and industry

What Will Make You Successful

• Ph.D. in Food Chemistry and Food Sciences with knowledge of flavor generation and transformation, ideally with industrial experience

• Research and applied science experience in the field of reaction flavours, Maillard reactions, lipid oxidations, and linking to sensory benefits

• Practical experience in analytical laboratory, with a focus on volatile and non-volatiles (GC-MS, GC-O, LC/MS)

• Proficiency in programming languages, e.g. Python & R, and experience in statistical analysis (e.g., PLS and PCA) and data visualization

• Basic knowledge of sensory techniques

• Ability to translate complex scientific results to easily understood way that instils credibility across different stakeholders

• Excellent communication skills in English (written/spoken)

• Networking skills and proactivity

• People at Core: Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively in diverse teams, fostering an environment that encourages fresh thinking and values contributions. Display openness, flexibility, and creativity in problem-solving while cultivating strong networking and teamwork abilities

• Innovation at Heart: Proven track record in driving innovative projects that challenge the status quo and contribute to breakthrough solutions, alongside experience in modeling or diet formulation

• Driven by Passion, Inspired by People: Strong commitment to promoting well-being and a positive workplace culture, ensuring all team members feel valued

descriptionByLocale.en:
Location: Orbe, Switzerland
Work model: On site / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Target start date: As soon as possible

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As Machine Quality Senior Specialist at Nestlé Product Technology Center for Coffee & Beverages , your mission is to build trust and deliver outstanding consumer experiences by embedding food safety, compliance and quality into beverage systems of both Nespresso and Nestlé Dolce Gusto from the earliest design stages. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with project managers, category teams, factories, regulatory and legal partners, consumer services and suppliers. This is your opportunity to drive cutting-edge innovation, strengthen your expertise and deliver meaningful results to create unique consumer experiences at global scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Machine Quality Senior Specialist

• Safeguarding food safety, regulatory compliance and consumer expectations throughout beverage-system development.

• Embedding quality by design across new products, packaging, machines and production lines to improve right-first-time delivery.

• Driving robust validation plans, quality requirements and process capability from ideation through technical approval and launch.

• Anticipating quality risks through root-cause analysis, risk assessment and failure mode analysis, enabling pragmatic decisions.

• Resolving quality issues with factories and consumer service teams and ensuring corrective actions strengthen future developments.

• Building quality capability by coaching colleagues, sharing knowledge across sites and turning project lessons into continuous improvement.

What will make you successful

• Bringing strong knowledge of quality systems, food safety, good manufacturing practices, product development and manufacturing.

• Applying root-cause analysis, risk analysis and failure mode analysis to complex design and production challenges.

• Using project management skills to align priorities, manage several developments and deliver practical solutions.

• Collaborating assertively and transparently, influencing decisions while balancing quality requirements with business realities.

• Demonstrating agility and adaptability while navigating complexity, shifting priorities and evolving project needs.

• Communicating fluently and effectively in English across all levels of the organization; proficiency in additional languages is an advantage.

At Nestlé, we care about our people

We offer a competitive and well-rounded benefits package designed to support your growth and wellbeing at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process
We are committed to a fair and transparent internal hiring process and ensure all applications are treated confidentially.

Your application will typically include an initial review, conversations with Talent Acquisition and the hiring team, followed by a final discussion.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and grow through experiences that push you further.

En tant qu’Opérateur.trice torréfaction en horaire d’équipe 4x8 (H/F/D), vous serez responsable d’assurer le fonctionnement des installations de torréfaction.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Work model: Hybrid / Full time
Contract type / duration: Permanent

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

As a Global Medical Communication Lead at Nestlé Nutrition and Health, your mission is to shape global, healthcare professional-centred communication for the premium vitamin, mineral and supplement portfolio, translating the latest science into compelling branded and non-branded engagements that support new and existing products. You’ll make a difference by collaborating closely with marketing, regulatory and scientific affairs, nutrition science, research and development, regional and market teams, external agencies, research partners and scientific experts. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.

How you’ll make an impact as a Global Medical Communication Lead

• Developing global engagement and communication plans that strengthen healthcare professional understanding and increase recommendation, advocacy and adoption across the premium vitamin, mineral and supplement portfolio.

• Creating compelling scientific communication materials across in-person, digital and social channels to support new product launches and established product concepts.

• Shaping market awareness initiatives that build scientific credibility and support sustainable portfolio growth.

• Leading global programmes, congress activities, round tables and branded and non-branded advisory engagements that deepen trusted relationships with healthcare professionals.

• Collaborating across global, regional and market teams to deliver communication toolkits that are relevant, consistent and ready for local adoption.

• Building productive partnerships with scientific experts and key opinion leaders (KOLs), agencies and research partners to turn insight and evidence into meaningful engagement.

What will make you successful

• Bringing substantial medical marketing experience in nutrition, pharmaceuticals or consumer healthcare environments.

• Applying scientific and regulatory awareness, including familiarity with external guidelines and regulations relevant to healthcare professional and advocacy relations to develop credible branded and non-branded healthcare professional programmes and materials.

• Using strategic planning, data analysis and project leadership to move multiple priorities from insight to action, with global experience highly preferred.

• Collaborating with influence and integrity across global teams while building trusted internal and external relationships.

• Communicating fluently in English.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.

At Nestlé Nutrition and Health, we place people at the heart of everything we do.

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Performance based bonus

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

• Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.

The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. We review applications as they are received and close the role once a strong list of relevant candidates is identified, so we encourage you to apply early. All information is treated confidentially.

Stay vigilant: Nestlé will only contact candidates via official company email addresses and will never ask for payments or sensitive personal information at any stage of the hiring process.

Ready to Be a Force for Good?

Apply now and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Location: Vevey, Switzerland
Act. Rate: Full-Time, 100%
Contract type / duration: Permanent contract

Start date: February 2027

Deadline for applications: 25 September 2026

Be a force for good and grow through experiences that push you further

As the Head of Global Business Services Finance at Nestlé, your mission is to act as a key finance partner to the Head of GBS and the GBS Management Team. You will shape the financial roadmap, challenge business decisions, and ensure disciplined planning, performance management, cost transparency and value realization across the global GBS network. Working closely with Center Heads, End-to-End solution leads, Global Process Owners, Markets, IT & Digital, and external partners, you will provide forward-looking insights, enable fact-based decisions, and strengthen accountability for financial outcomes. You will lead an international finance team in different locations and help GBS deliver sustainable efficiency, effectiveness, and business value.

How you’ll make an impact as a Head of GBS Finance

• Bring deep expertise in the operational financial management of Global Business Services, using cost, efficiency, quality and service-performance insights to improve both efficiency and effectiveness.

• While leveraging AI tools, develop and maintain unit-cost, productivity and service-performance measures that connect financial outcomes with operational volumes, quality and service levels. Use internal and external benchmarks to identify improvement opportunities.

• Planning, coordinating and maintaining cost control of our Business Centers operations, measuring performance against plan and proposing necessary action plans to achieve targets in a context of important transition plan.

• Ensure challenging stretched targets are set for each Shared Service Center, end-to-end solution lead and Management Services unit, and tracking performance in a timely manner.

• Establish and govern a consistent framework to validate, track and report productivity, transformation benefits and value delivery, including agreed baselines, ownership, timing and reconciliation to reported financial results.

• Ensure a robust, documented and transparent billing and reconciliation process across the GBS network, including accurate and timely charges to internal customers, clear allocation drivers, dispute resolution and compliance with applicable transfer-pricing and accounting requirements.

• Own and continuously improve a transparent, driver-based costing and charging model for GBS services. Define financial evaluation and performance-tracking methodologies, assess business cases and contract changes, and ensure continuity plans reflect current financial exposures and operational requirements.

• Lead financial and commercial governance of external service providers, including contract economics, rate cards, indexation, volume commitments, service credits, change requests, invoice validation and value-for-money assessments.

• Lead, develop and inspire your team in an international environment while working collaboratively and cross functionally with IT & Digital, Global Process Owners and Markets.

What will make you successful

• Demonstrating senior finance leadership experience in GBS operational financial models and in complex global organizations, supported by relevant finance, accounting or business qualification.

• Applying financial analysis and co-piloting experience to various senior stakeholders through a strong command of management accounting, planning and forecasting, service costing, investment appraisal, financial controls and commercial contract management.

• Developing and improving financial systems and major business processes, with exposure to audit, project financial evaluation and contract reviews.

• Strong focus on compliance, rock solid reporting and internal controls.

• Managing and developing people, including virtual teams, with good organizational and planning skills.

• Communicating fluently in English, with superior written and verbal communication skills to effectively address and influence all levels, leadership team and internal customers.

• Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning, while translating ideas into measurable impact and creating shared value.

At Nestlé, we care about our people

Our benefits are designed to support your growth and wellbeing, so you can thrive at work and in life:

• Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities

• Performance based bonus

• Paid holidays beyond legal requirements

• Learning and development opportunities to grow your career

• Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

• Strong employer contribution to your pension plan

• Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions

What to expect from our hiring process

We are committed to a fair and transparent hiring process and ensure all applications are treated confidentially.

Your application will typically include an initial review, conversations with Talent Acquisition, and the hiring team, followed by a final discussion.

Ready to grow with us?

Apply now and grow through experiences that push you further.
